text:
maria_ae: Heads-up — EdgeWorks just pushed their decision to EOW. They need answers on Dedicated SLA + KMS/HSM before legal okays the POC. Asking for exec help to speed this.

dan_se: I can spin a dedicated POC cluster today, but we need exact KMS flow and whether they require customer-managed keys (HSM). If yes, we need the keywrap API spec from GCP/AWS/Azure.

emma_edgeworks_pm: Confirming: we require envelope encryption with our KMS, plus an audit trail for key usage. Also need price estimate for 24h reserved capacity for 2 weeks.

leo_security: For HSM/KMS integration we need: SOC2 report, latest pen test summary, network/dataflow diagram, and the KMS integration doc. We currently have SOC2 type II (org-level) but no customer-managed HSM guide yet.

maria_ae: Customer is pressing. If we don't show workable KMS + a price they approve, they'll sign with a competitor. Need an executive escalation to commit engineering/legal to a one-business-day turnaround on artifacts.

ashley_vp_sales: @maria_ae i'm on standby. I'll take point with EdgeWorks execs tomorrow morning. @leo_security can you confirm if we can produce a one-day artifact bundle (SOC2 cert + draft KMS integration plan + temporary attestation)?

leo_security: I can compile SOC2 & pen test in <24h. For a proper HSM integration guide we'll need help from infra eng — Dan, can you provide a minimal KMS flow (how Redwood routes keys, whether KEKs are stored, etc.) so security can draft the customer-facing doc?

rit a_legal: (note: corrected name) WAIT not Rita_legal. Sorry, typing glitch.

rita_legal: We have an NDA already inbound per JIRA-7892. I can prioritize the DPA and add a clause for BYOK/HSM. Need the technical spec to add the exact language. I can fast-track to 24–48h on legal review if we get the spec today.

dan_se: Draft KMS flow below — can iterate.

```
KMS integration (minimal):
- Customer provides KMS key (BYOK) in their cloud tenant.
- Redwood fetches wrapped keys via a secure connector with mutual TLS.
- Runtime unwraps into ephemeral memory; KEKs never persisted on disk.
- Audit events emitted to customer SIEM via syslog/HTTPS webhook.
```

dan_se: Also: test cluster endpoint: https://staging-redwood.edgeworks-poc.internal (creds via 1password).

emma_edgeworks_pm: That flow looks acceptable in principle. Need confirmation that ephemeral keys will not be logged and that we can get key usage logs to our SIEM.

leo_security: Confirmed — ephemeral keys only in RAM, zero disk persistence. We'll add explicit logging exclusion and an example syslog payload format in the doc.

maria_ae: Pricing ask from customer: what's the delta on cost for Dedicated reserved 24/7 for 2 weeks vs. Hosted burst? They want a committed number to include in their procurement.

ashley_vp_sales: @dan_se and @maria_ae can you share a ballpark before I talk to their CFO? We can later formalize.

dan_se: Ballpark math: Dedicated reserved pool for 2 GPUs x 2 weeks with support + SLA ~ $28k. Hosted burst for same throughput ~ $42k (higher per-token). I can produce a formal quote today.

emma_edgeworks_pm: We were budgeting ~$30k. If you can do $30k with BYOK + SLA, we can sign.

ashley_vp_sales: Noted. I'll tell them we can hit ~$30k contingent on legal + security sign-off. I'll schedule an exec call for 9am PT tomorrow. Who from our side can join?

maria_ae: I can, Leo can, Dan probably for 30 mins to answer KMS Qs. Rita can join if legal needs to be on the call.

rita_legal: I'll be on standby, but prefer to review the draft DPA first. I'll join if there's time-sensitive language to negotiate.

deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: JIRA-8065 — EDGEWORKS-ESCL (assigned: dan_se, leo_security, rita_legal).

leo_security: Action items: 1) Security bundle (SOC2 + pen test + draft KMS integration) — leo_security (ETA 24h). 2) Draft quote for $30k path — dan_se (ETA 6h). 3) Draft DPA addendum for BYOK — rita_legal (ETA 24–48h). 4) Exec call 9am PT — ashley_vp_sales to lead.

maria_ae: Adding internal note: deal stage = procurement; risk = high without BYOK/HSM doc. Executives looped.

ashley_vp_sales: I'll send a calendar invite and draft a 5-slide exec summary we can use on the call. Thanks team — this one looks winnable if we move fast. :rocket: 

emma_edgeworks_pm: Appreciate the quick response. We'll standby after your call.

maria_ae: Will update thread after call. TY everyone. :pray:
